title: Stitchbroadcast
description: a easy broadcast plugin easy configurable
body:
📢 EasyBroadcast — Simple, Powerful Announcements for Your Server
Take full control of your server's announcements with EasyBroadcast — the most straightforward broadcast plugin for Spigot & Paper servers. Designed with simplicity in mind, everything is configured through a clean, well-commented config.yml — no coding required.
✨ Features:

Easy Configuration — Get up and running in minutes. Every option is clearly labeled and ready to customize straight out of the box.
Custom Messages — Write your own announcements exactly the way you want them. Support for placeholders lets you personalize every message.
Scheduled Broadcasts — Set your messages on a timer and let the plugin do the work. Define intervals per message for full flexibility.
Multi-World Support — Target specific worlds or channels with tailored messages, keeping announcements relevant for every part of your server.
Full Color & Formatting Support — Use & color codes and formatting tags to make your broadcasts pop with bold text, italics, gradients, and more.

⚙️ Perfect for:
Network servers, survival worlds, mini-game hubs, or any server that wants clean, automated communication with players.
